program_name: Bachelor of Education (Honours) in Early Childhood Education

fees.notes: Estimated total fees (local) for full course duration

requirements.general_text: Any of these: STPM: A pass in STPM with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in any 2 subjects or its equivalent. STAM: A pass in STAM with a minimum grade of Jayyid. UEC: A pass in UEC with a minimum Grade B in any 5 subjects. Matriculation or Foundation: Matriculation/Foundation or its equivalent, with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Diploma in Early Childhood Education: A Diploma in Early Childhood Education (Level 4, MQF) with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Diploma: A Diploma (Level 4, MQF) in any field or its equivalent. APEL A English Proficiency (For International Students ): Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) score of 500; OR International English Language Testing System (IELTS) score of 5.0; OR equivalent.
